instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pull the direct messages of my Instagram professional account", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:pull-my-instagram-messages and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads the conversations of the Instagram professional account the token belongs to (through the Instagram messaging API, not by logging in as a person) and the newest messages of each, and answers them. Each conversation carries the service's own description of it (its participants) in source. A message pulled twice appears once.
4. It reads and writes no rows: the new or changed conversations and items are in the answer, and held.cursor is what to hand back next time.
